title: JBC announces opening of vacancies for first, second-level court judges
summary: The openings for the first and second court judges are for the National Capital Judicial Region and Regions 1 to 12.

blocks.text: The logo of the Supreme Court at the Supreme Court Building in Manila.
MANILA, Philippines — The Judicial and Bar Council (JBC) has announced the opening of vacancies in several first- and second-level courts across the country.
In an announcement on Tuesday, November 3, the JBC said that the deadline for the submission of online documents is on December 18 at 4:30 p.m.
The openings for the first and second court judges are for the National Capital Judicial Region and Regions 1 to 12.
Full documentation requirements are found on the JBC’s website.
